title: Day Trading - Why You'll Almost Certainly Fail
summary: Reviews academic studies showing most day traders lose money, under one percent beat an index fund after fees, and only the top few percent earn even minimum wage.

assertions.quote: study after study has proven that the majority of day traders don't even make a profit they lose money day trading

verdicts.note: Of 1,551 Brazilians who day traded mini-Ibovespa futures for more than 300 days, 97% lost money net of fees; average daily net profit was -US$48.81 and the median -US$23.21.

Complete Taiwan Stock Exchange data 1992-2006: day traders lose 7 bps a day before costs and 23.9 bps after, reliably negative in every year but 1992; day trading is an industry that consistently loses money.
EU regulators' studies found 74-89% of retail CFD accounts lose money, with average losses of 1,600 to 29,000 per investor; CFDs are short-term leveraged speculation rather than day trading as such.

assertions.quote: less than 1% of day traders are able to predictably and reliably earn positive abnormal returns net of fee

verdicts.note: Predictably profitable day traders are under 3% of all day traders on an average day and generate under 10% of day-trading volume.
Of 1,551 day traders persisting 300+ days, 3.0% were net profitable and 0.5% earned more than a bank teller, with success rates declining with days traded as in roulette.

assertions.quote: now it's atom versus gigantic hedge fund supported by quants

verdicts.note: Individuals' average daily loss is 19% higher when the HFT share of deals rises 10 points, and the authors conclude it is virtually impossible to compete with HFTs; the venue is index futures rather than large-cap stocks.

assertions.quote: it is virtually impossible for an individual to day trade for a living

verdicts.note: The Brazilian futures study found only the top few percent of persistent day traders earned more than minimum wage.

Of 47 net-profitable persistent day traders, only 17 earned above Brazilian minimum wage (US$16/day) and 8 above a bank teller's starting pay (US$54/day), the latter with daily standard deviations of US$632-3,308.

assertions.quote: over time index funds have consistently outperformed almost every other super flashy investment tool
